title: For Occupancy Loss, the reference puts the B-flagged value (1178) in SUM OF A and the A-flagged value (1224) in SUM OF B, the reverse of the workbook's own flags.
confirmation: In the reference 'Income Statement', R124 (=K125, 1178) is flagged S124='B' and R125 (=K124, 1224) is flagged S125='A', yet SUM OF A R132 = +K125 (1178) and SUM OF B R134 = +K124 (1224), the reverse of the markers; a solver summing by the A/B flags gets swapped values and the judge compares to this
